title: Biscuit
summary: The groundsman's old dog has run off with Saturday's match ball and won't give it back to anyone. A season on she's slower, and she still brings the ball to you.

ends.title: Her ball
ends.text: The groundsman's dog brought you the ball every morning until she couldn't.

ends.title: Just a dog
ends.text: It was only a dog, and you had training.

beats.title: Biscuit

event.title: Biscuit
event.speaker: groundsman
setup: {groundsman.name}'s dog Biscuit is lying in the centre circle of pitch one with Saturday's match ball between her paws. She's thirteen and she's growling at the assistant manager.

say: {groundsman.short} doesn't help. "She'll give it to someone she likes. She doesn't like many. Go on."

replies.label: Sit down on the grass and wait.

say: "Sausage. The canteen does them on a Tuesday. It's Thursday."

replies.label: Sit down on the grass and wait.

sat.text: You sit on the wet grass for six minutes. She gets up, drops the ball in your lap and lies down against your leg. {groundsman.short} says that's the first time in four years.

chased.text: She runs straight through the bit he reseeded on Monday, and so do you. You get the ball. You also get a lecture about the root depth of rye grass.

beats.hint: The groundsman's dog has the match ball

beats.title: Slower

event.title: Slower
event.speaker: groundsman
setup: A season on. Biscuit walks now instead of running, and she's grey round the nose. She's got a training ball in her mouth and she's walking over to you.
{if arc.path=='sat'}She's done this every morning since the centre circle.{/if}
{if arc.path=='chased'}She hasn't been near you since the reseeding.{/if}

choices.label: Throw it for her before training.

outcomes.text: She goes after it slowly, comes back slowly and drops it on your boot. You do it eleven times and you're late out. {groundsman.short} watches from the mower and doesn't say anything.
She lies down by the fence with the ball and waits for someone else.

beats.hint: A season on, the groundsman's dog is slower
